subject: Ephemeral evidence proxy / Vendr API onboarding request
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@heliosai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliosai.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding — API-based evidence sync (ephemeral creds)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick intro at re:platform last week. HeliosAI is ready to onboard our security profile into Vendr (we currently have a OneTrust space, but want a mirrored Vendr profile for your intake). Instead of manual uploads we propose an API-based sync: our security team can push CAIQ/SIG fragments and SOC 2 artifacts to a Vendr ingestion endpoint using short-lived credentials (rotate every hour).

High-level attachments: sync-flow.png (diagram) — it shows an ephemeral-token presign flow + HMAC auth.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood accept an API ingestion workflow into Vendr (or a Vendr-compatible bucket)?
- Any minimum field-mapping expectations for CAIQ fragments (we can supply a sample mapping)?
- Security review: we'll need an RFC on your API auth expectations and any IP allowlist requirements.

We can start with a scoped project: 1) test push of a CAIQ fragment 2) validate SOC 2 attestation file presence 3) flip to scheduled delta sync.

Proposal: schedule a 30-min technical sync this week (we're in PST). Raj (cc) will be our engineering lead.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Trust & Security, HeliosAI
elena@heliosai.com

---
Attachment: sync-flow.png (PNG diagram, 260KB stub)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@heliosai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — API-based evidence sync (ephemeral creds)

Hi Elena — great to hear and thanks for the diagram. This is the kind of flow we prefer (automated sync keeps profiles current). A few quick clarifying questions so we can scope the MLP: 

1) Field mapping: can you share a one-page CSV of CAIQ fields you plan to push (example: control_id, evidence_url, evidence_type, last_modified)? Karthik will use that to confirm Vendr/OneTrust equivalence.
2) Auth & rotation: are you proposing OAuth2 with short-lived tokens or HMAC-signed presigned requests? Either works but we need the exact token rollover cadence and revocation options.
3) SLA & throughput: expected delta size and frequency (events/min or MB/hour) — helps sizing for dedicated ingestion.
4) Access & attestations: please upload SOC 2 Type II and SIG/CAIQ snapshot to the portal or share a signed link (DocuSign) so Legal can record proof of attestation.

If this looks good I'll loop in Karthik and Jonas for the mapping + ingestion API questions. I'm available for a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PST; Raj's timezones work fine too.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Putting myself down to lead the mapping and staging test. Initial notes:

- I'll produce a CAIQ field mapping CSV (attached: caiaq_field_map.csv) with control_id -> vendr_field, evidence_type normalization, and required/optional flags.
- Auth recommendation: OAuth2 client_credentials issuing JWTs with 1h TTL + middleware token introspection. HMAC presign works for S3 flows (we can do presign for large artifacts).
- For initial testing we can open a temporary S3-backed ingestion bucket (staging.redwood-vendr.com) with presign endpoints; Jonas can confirm bucket lifecycle.

Plan: I'll send the mapping and a short ingest spec by end of day tomorrow and then schedule a 30-min mapping workshop with Helios (Karthik + Jonas + Grace + Raj).
